description: This PHP class 'PimCsvDataImportService' provides functionality for importing CSV data related to HR employee information within the OrangeHRM system. It defines header row constants, manages a dependency on 'CsvDataImportService', and contains an 'import' method to execute data import.

classes.name: PimCsvDataImportService
classes.description: Service class responsible for importing employee data from CSV files into the HR system, using predefined header constants and delegating the actual CSV import processing to 'CsvDataImportService'.

methods.name: getCsvDataImportService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the CsvDataImportService instance.

methods.name: setCsvDataImportService
methods.description: Sets the CsvDataImportService dependency, allowing for dependency injection.

methods.name: import
methods.description: Performs the import of CSV content by passing content, import type, and header row constants to the CsvDataImportService.
